profile_text.body:
Humane Intelligence is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 2022 and headquartered in Katy, Texas. It describes itself as dedicated to breaking down barriers to AI deployment for social good, and says it collaboratively designs and runs rigorous evaluations that make AI systems more accountable, responsible, and fair.

Its work is offered as paid services rather than products. AI red teaming is described as a semi-structured testing approach that assesses and improves the safety and effectiveness of AI models and systems by identifying vulnerabilities, limitations, and potential areas for improvement; the company runs red teaming events using its own software, which it says it will release under an open source software license in 2026. AI Contextual Evaluations are described as rigorous, mixed-method, bespoke evaluations giving a comprehensive analysis of a model or system's performance for a specified problem space, and the company says it is rapidly developing knowledge graph and ontological AI problem space mapping and contextual evaluations in 2026. Bias bounties are collaboratively designed sets of challenges bringing together researchers, impacted communities, and domain experts to examine and improve AI and machine learning systems, models, and datasets. The final self-hosted bias bounty closed in November 2025, and in 2026 the company is working to move the program onto Zindi, a global data science challenge platform.

No lawsuits involving the company are recorded, and its recorded legal exposure is listed under Texas. No MCP servers and no separate products are recorded. The company invites inquiries about hiring, pricing, and its work by email at info [at] humane-intelligence [dot] org or through a contact form, and points recent philanthropic funding recipients implementing a generative AI model or system for the first time to its AI evaluations offerings overview.
